subject.title: [Feature]: Support arbitrary workspace files in bootstrap context injection

question: Should `bootstrap-extra-files` accept explicitly configured custom-basename workspace files as a core hook contract, or remain limited to recognized bootstrap filenames?
rationale: The change affects deterministic system-prompt context and the public file-loading contract for hook configuration, which is a product/security boundary rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Approve Repaired Hook Contract
options.body: Allow custom-basename files through the existing hook path after the linked PR or replacement is rebased and preserves guards, budgets, and filtering.

options.title: Keep Recognized Basenames Only
options.body: Reject arbitrary workspace-file injection and keep custom context in existing AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md-style files or narrower first-class filename proposals.

options.title: Defer To Broader Context API
options.body: Keep this issue open as design input until a broader context or capability-discovery contract is chosen.

recommendation.title: Approve Repaired Hook Contract
recommendation.body: Allow custom-basename files through the existing hook path after the linked PR or replacement is rebased and preserves guards, budgets, and filtering.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the original bootstrap-extra-files work and has later boundary-safe bootstrap read history in the same area.
